summary: Hyperlocal marketplace with Customer, Shopkeeper, and Admin portals. Customers browse shops by location filter, view products by category (Grocery, Electronics, Fashion), add to cart, and checkout. Shopkeepers manage inventory with online/offline toggle, upload product photos, and view orders. Admin dashboard for shop approval, transaction monitoring (2% commission tracking), and user management. Mobile-first responsive design with Internet Identity authentication. Uses Motoko backend (not Firebase). No real-time geolocation, push notifications, AI image analysis, or live tracking.
architectural_notes: Three-tier role system: Customer, Shopkeeper, Admin with Internet Identity authentication
Motoko backend for data persistence (not Firebase)
Location filtering by city/area instead of GPS-based geolocation
Manual order status checks instead of real-time push notifications
Shopkeeper subscription model: ₹25/year tracked in admin analytics
2% platform commission on sales tracked in digital ledger
known_issues: No real-time geolocation - shops filtered by manually set city/area
No push notifications - users check order status manually
No AI image analysis for product suggestions from photos
No real-time inventory sync - updates occur on user actions
No live delivery tracking on map

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication with three role types: Customer, Shopkeeper, and Admin using Internet Identity
Create Customer portal with shop browsing filtered by manually set city/area location
Implement category-based product search with predefined categories: Grocery, Electronics, Fashion, Home & Garden, Health & Beauty, Sports & Outdoors
Build shopping cart with Quick-Add functionality and quantity adjustment
Create secure checkout process that calculates order total, applies 2% platform commission, and records transaction
Implement My Orders section for customers showing order history with status tracking
Add Return/Exchange request functionality allowing customers to submit requests for completed orders
Create Shopkeeper portal with online/offline status toggle visible to customers
Build inventory management system for shopkeepers to add, edit, and delete products with photo upload
Implement order management dashboard for shopkeepers to view incoming orders and update order status
Create digital ledger for shopkeepers showing sales history with 2% platform commission breakdown per transaction
Build Admin dashboard with secure login and overview showing platform-wide statistics
Implement shop management system for admin to approve/verify new shop registrations and view shop performance metrics
Create transaction analytics dashboard for admin showing total sales, pending 2% commissions, and subscription tracking
Build user support ticket system for admin to manage disputes between customers and shopkeepers
Implement global settings panel for admin to adjust platform-wide delivery radius filter and manage platform configuration
Design mobile-first responsive UI with Trust-Blue and Success-Green color palette across all portals
